findings.title: Exit-code parameter breaks process error listeners
findings.description: `src/index.ts` registers `handleError` directly for `uncaughtException` and `unhandledRejection`. Those events supply a second argument—an origin string or Promise—which now becomes `exitCode`. Consequently, `process.exit(exitCode)` throws instead of terminating cleanly. Wrap both listeners with `(err) => handleError(err)` and add regression tests.

findings.title: Fix mode can report success while required fields remain missing
findings.description: `remaining` only tracks original findings whose fixes failed. However, `validateFrontmatter` returns immediately when `docType` is missing. Fixing an inferred `docType` can therefore reveal additional missing fields, yet this command exits successfully without checking them. Revalidate after applying fixes and derive the exit status from the resulting findings. Add a real-service regression test.

findings.title: Validation ignores the resolved worktree
findings.description: The command discards `worktreeId` and always validates `project.projectPath`. From a registered worktree, a default run therefore checks—and `--fix` modifies—the main project checkout. Explicit worktree paths are instead filtered out as outside that root. Use the existing `resolveOperationPath` helper and test worktree-local validation.

findings.title: Value-constraint test never exercises rejection
findings.description: The test claims to catch a wrong `docType`, but every assertion expects zero findings. Its inputs exercise valid schema lookup and intentional unknown-type passthrough, not rejection. Rename it to describe those behaviors and remove the contradictory comments, or add a test that actually exercises a violated constraint.
